preconditions.description: The length of string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= b <= len(S) and 1 <= c <= d <= len(T) for a, b, c, d in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices for substrings of S and T.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length equal to the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] in {'0', '1'} for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i] == '1') == (can_transform(S[a-1:b], T[c-1:d])) for i, (a, b, c, d) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: The output must correctly indicate whether each query's transformation is possible.
